verdict.rationale: Operating an LLM observability platform through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no such feature. HQL is a structured query language, the Playground is for testing prompts sent to models, and llms.txt and docs markdown help agents read the docs rather than operate the product. These are adjacent at most and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
